reason: Re-opened packet.js veda 93 --verse 9.1.6 and the pinned revision 339335 by action=raw (API timestamp 2022-06-24). There Sāyaṇa glosses sūryasya duhitā as śraddhā devī and cites the Vājasaneyins: śraddhā vai sūryasya duhitā śraddhā hy enaṃ punāti. In his context enam is the Soma he is commenting on, and Wilson's note 4 renders it 'she purifies him', so 'for whom Faith purifies Soma' holds. verse.js ok (9.1.6 at [723,6]). 9.1 opens Mandala 9 and its ten verses cover pressing (vv. 1 and 7), the fleece (v. 6) and the milk (v. 9). The plain sense is faithful, although in the hymn the fleece comes before the press. entry-check ok. No school, comparison or tone problem.
